title: mapContracts
responsibility: Maps selected contracts to their recorded dependencies and dependents using bounded, deduplicated breadth-first traversal.

inputs.name: mapContracts.entries
inputs.description: Eligible complete catalog used to resolve edges and build the reverse dependency index; source is never inspected.

inputs.name: mapContracts.matches
inputs.description: Selected owning records that form traversal roots and remain separate from dependency and dependent results.

inputs.name: mapContracts.query
inputs.description: Original requested identity or path, preserved as the returned map query label.

inputs.name: mapContracts.depth
inputs.description: Relationship hops to traverse; CLI admission allows integers from zero through ten, with zero returning roots only.

outputs.name: mapContracts
outputs.description: Roots plus separately sorted dependency and dependent summaries and unresolved ids. Roots are excluded from neighbors, cycles are bounded, and repeated edges expand each distinct frontier id once.

errors.name: Caller accessor or iterator rejection
errors.description: Direct in-memory callers can supply getters, iterators or array species; any error they throw propagates. CLI JSON contains plain data, with no such overrides.
